tex_content.html:
Lemma

↗ lem:alternating-cauchy-binet

For every $\omega \in \Lambda ^k(V^*)$, \[ k!\, \omega =\sum _{u:\{ 1,\ldots ,k\} \to \iota '}\omega (e_{u(1)},\ldots ,e_{u(k)})\, e_{u(1)}^\flat \wedge \cdots \wedge e_{u(k)}^\flat . \]
Proof

↗ lem:alternating-cauchy-binet \sketch Evaluate both sides on basis tuples and apply alternating Cauchy–Binet with the matrix $\langle e_{v(i)},e_m\rangle $.

□
